description_en: You can call the DescribeCenRouteMaps operation to query the configurations of routing policies
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRouteMaps接口查询路由策略中已配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-route-maps --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-wx12mmlt17ld820000 --route-map-id cenrmap-y40mxdvf7joc120000 --cen-region-id cn-hangzhou --transmit-direction RegionOut --transit-router-route-table-id vtb-gw8nx3515m1mbd1z10000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenRouteMaps

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值：10

parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.name: route_map_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the routing policy is applied.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
路由策略应用的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: cen_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The direction in which the routing policy is applied. Valid values:

RegionIn: Inbound. The routing policy is applied to routes that are advertised to the gateway of a region.

For example, routes are advertised from network instances in the current region to the gateway of the current region, or routes from other regions are advertised to the gateway of the current region.

RegionOut: Outbound. The routing policy is applied to routes that are advertised from the gateway of a region.

For example, routes are advertised from the gateway of the current region to network instances in the current region, or to gateways in other regions
parameters.help_zh:
路由策略的应用方向。取值：

RegionIn：入地域网关方向，表示路由传入云企业网地域网关的方向。

 例如：路由从本地域的网络实例发布到本地域网关，或其他地域的路由发布到本地域网关。

RegionOut：出地域网关方向，表示路由传出云企业网地域网关的方向。

 例如：路由从本地域网关发布到本地域下的网络实例，或发布到其他地域的地域网关
parameters.name: transmit_direction

parameters.help_zh: 路由策略关联的转发路由器路由表ID

items.description_en: The information about the routing policy

AsPathMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode for the AS-path.

Include: fuzzy match. The match is successful if the AS-path of the route overlaps with the AS-path in the match condition.

Complete: exact match. The match is successful only if the AS-path of the route is the same as the AS-path in the match condition
AsPathMatchMode.description_zh:
AS Path列表的匹配模式。

Include：模糊匹配，匹配条件中的AS Path与被匹配路由的AS Path有重叠即判定为匹配成功。 

Complete：精确匹配，匹配条件中的AS Path必须与被匹配路由的AS Path一致，才判定为匹配成功。

CenId.description_en: The ID of the CEN instance

CenRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the routing policy is applied

CidrMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode for the prefix list. Valid values:

Include: fuzzy match. The match is successful if the route prefix in the match condition includes the route prefix of the route.

For example, a policy with the 10.10.0.0/16 route prefix matches the 10.10.1.0/24 route.

Complete: exact match. The match is successful only if the route prefix in the match condition is the same as the route prefix of the route.

For example, a policy with the 10.10.0.0/16 route prefix matches only the 10.10.0.0/16 route
CidrMatchMode.description_zh:
前缀列表的匹配模式。取值：

Include：模糊匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。

 例如：定义10.10.0.0/16的策略可以模糊匹配到10.10.1.0/24的路由。

Complete：精确匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。 

 例如：定义10.10.0.0/16的策略仅可以精确匹配到10.10.0.0/16的路由

CommunityMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode for the community.

Include: fuzzy match. The match is successful if the community of the route overlaps with the community in the match condition.

Complete: exact match. The match is successful only if the community of the route is the same as the community in the match condition
CommunityMatchMode.description_zh:
Community的匹配模式。

Include：模糊匹配，匹配条件中的Community与被匹配路由的Community有重叠即判定为匹配成功。 

Complete：精确匹配，匹配条件中的Community必须与被匹配路由的Community一致，才判定为匹配成功

CommunityOperateMode.description_en:
The action to be performed on the community.

Additive: adds the community to the route.

Replace: replaces the original community of the route.

This parameter specifies the action to be performed after a route meets the match conditions
CommunityOperateMode.description_zh:
Community的执行模式。

Additive：添加，表示为路由添加Community。

Replace：替换，表示替换路由原有的Community。

本参数表示路由通过匹配条件后，要执行的操作

DestinationChildInstanceType.description_en:
A list of destination instance types to be matched.

VPC: VPC.

VBR: VBR.

CCN: CCN.

VPN: IPsec connection.

This parameter takes effect only when the routing policy is applied to the outbound direction of the regional gateway and the destination instance is in the current region
DestinationChildInstanceType.description_zh:

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

VPN：IPsec连接。

仅路由策略的应用方向为出地域网关方向，且目的实例类型为本地域下的实例类型时，目的实例类型列表才会生效

MapResult.description_en:
The action that is performed after all match conditions are met.

Permit: allows the matched route.

Deny: denies the matched route
MapResult.description_zh:
所有匹配条件都通过后的策略行为。

Deny：拒绝被匹配的路由通过

MatchAddressType.description_en:
The IP address family of the route.

IPv4: matches only IPv4 routes.

IPv6: matches only IPv6 routes.

If this parameter is not returned, both IPv4 and IPv6 routes are matched
MatchAddressType.description_zh:
